claim_ceiling: TF-IDF family at 174k: adversarial gates PASS (8/8 reps), citation heritage AUC PASS (4/8 reps), ALL OTHER BENCHMARKS FAIL (hierarchy, cluster, boilerplate, cross-language, recall@10). Dense embeddings not ready. Metric learning passes adversarial but fails boilerplate at 1.2k scale.
evidence_summary: Audited 9 primary result files + specification + 6 scripts. Verified: (1) HNSW artifact fixed via exact k-NN on fixed stratified subsample n=2000; (2) All 8 TF-IDF reps PASS both adversarial gates (lang_dom 0.485-0.511, jurist_pref 0.615-0.727); (3) Citation heritage: 4/8 reps PASS AUC-ROC (0.66-0.84), ALL FAIL recall@10 (max 0.0066 vs 0.2 threshold); (4) v17b label normalization NEGATIVE: uniform_improvement=false, zoom_fine degraded 11-16% on 4/8 citation-based reps; (5) v18 coarse hierarchy NEGATIVE: branch-level max purity 0.6497 < 0.7 threshold; (6) Dense embeddings (165k + 3yr) all FAIL jurist gate (JP 0.008-0.418); (7) Universal failures: boilerplate resistance (resistance_score -0.79 to -0.89), cross-language retrieval (recall@10 0.117-0.147 vs 0.2), hierarchy coherence (branch NMI ~0.001-0.03 vs 0.3). Metric learning (linear_metric_epoch4, 1.2k) passes adversarial + jurivoc + scale stability + cross-language, but FAILS boilerplate (-0.888). No leakage, no benchmark gaming, no prettiness-as-quality, all negatives honestly reported.
